outcome: detection of intrauterine lesions on office hysteroscopy
cohort: The study included 1726 infertile women who had sonographically normal uterine cavities.
finding: Abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB), hypomenorrhea, and previous dilation and curettage (D&C) are factors that increase the detection rate of intrauterine lesions on office hysteroscopy in infertile women with sonographically normal uterine cavities.
cross-section timing: early proliferative phase of the menstrual cycle
